data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Wednesday, September 2, 2026: Crypto prices tumble as Iran war reignites
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $77,395.89 on Wednesday, September 2, 2026, 1.5% lower than Tuesday's opening price. As of 7:13 a.m. ET, bitcoin moved down to $76,597.13. Ethereum opened at $2,417.66 today, down 2.0% from Tuesday's opening price. Ethereum fell further this morning to $2,373.76 as of 7:13 a.m. ET.
